blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Senate President Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III on Thursday appealed to the public, especially to content creators, to respect the dignity of persons with disabilities (PWDs). Pimentel made the pronouncement following a controversial episode of the now-terminated podcast “Machong Chismisan.” The podcast drew widespread criticisms after its hosts’ made derogatory remarks about Kris Aquino’s eldest son, Josh. “Calling someone ‘walang kuwenta’ (useless), and making fun of his condition is not comedy. It is cruelty. No person, especially someone with a disability, deserves to be treated that way,” he emphasized. “Just because a person has a disability does not […]...
